title: 658. Exclusive Time of Functions

examples.explanation: Function 0 runs during [0,1] and [6,6] (3 units); function 1 runs during [2,5] (4 units).
Nested and sequential self-calls merge to 8 units over [0,7].

hints: Push each started function onto a stack and remember the timestamp of the previous log.
On a start event, credit the gap since the previous stamp to the function on top, then push the new id.
On an end event, credit the inclusive gap (stamp - previous + 1) to the popped id and move the cursor past the stamp.
